name: [🛡️RAIDS] Slay 1 Million Zombies! ⚔️
desc:
Welcome to Slay Zombies! ⚔️

In this roguelike game, you can...

🧟‍♂️Slay tons of Zombies!
⚡Level up and unlock OP upgrades!
🛡️Survive for 10 minutes!
⭐Can you beat all the bosses and become the strongest?

🌀Updates Weekly!


Update v1.2 - Raids, Raid Armors, Gem Pass
NEW LIMITED BUNDLE
• NEW BLACK BEAST BUNDLE - Claim it before it leaves!

⚔️ Raids
• Hourly raid boss fights! Queue up in the lobby and fight a massive boss with other players
• 5 raid tiers with increasing difficulty and rewards
• Deal damage to earn draws - more damage = more rewards
• Earn coins, gems, rerolls, chests, and EXCLUSIVE raid-only armor sets
• The more players in the raid, the higher your damage boost

🛡️ New Armor Sets
• Goblin Armor Set (Legendary)
• Arachnid Armor Set (Epic)
• Raid-exclusive sets: Silent, SpacePirate, and Snow

💎 Gem Pass
• 30-day pass - claim 25 gems every day!
• Available in the shop

Open Next Chest
• Quickly open your next chest without going back to inventory
